title: Welcome to AIE CODE - Jed Borovik, Google DeepMind
talk_summary: This is a conference welcome/MC introduction by Jed Borovik (Google DeepMind) for the 2025 AI Engineering Code Summit in New York. It contains only logistics, sponsor thanks, audience warm-up, and framing of the event theme (AI coding); no technical content, techniques, or results are presented.
